purpose: Onboarding/welcome illustration matching the Scriptly PC desktop app's real UI framework (CustomTkinter, Windows)
status: design-only draft, not wired into any application code
brand_source: assets/BRAND.md (light-mode CustomTkinter palette: bg #f1f4f9, card #ffffff, header/navy #152847, teal accent #00b8ae, Segoe UI typography) and assets/icon_idle.png (soundwave mark reused as the app icon glyph)
copy_source: Reused verbatim from PROJECT.md / the app's own tagline: "Records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings — 100% offline." Step labels (Choose your audio sources / Start a recording / Get your summary) describe the app's actual 3-step flow (mic+system audio capture -> on-device transcription -> summary/task list) rather than invented marketing copy.
render_method: Local-only: hand-written HTML/CSS (welcome.html) mimicking a real Windows app window (native Win32-style minimize/maximize/close caption buttons, not macOS traffic lights) rendered to PNG with headless Chromium via Playwright (device_scale_factor=2), then converted to WebP with Pillow. No generative AI (Bloom or otherwise) was used.

If/when integrated, note the app itself is a CustomTkinter (Tkinter) window, not literally HTML/CSS, so this illustration is a reference mockup to guide a real CTk implementation, not a drop-in screen.
